en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Muhammed bin Sinan, from Abu’l-Jaroud, Ziyad bin Mundhir, from Abu Ja’far, Muhammed bin Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He: «Then flee to Allah. Indeed, I am, to you, from Him a clear warner.» [51:50] He said: Perform pilgrimage to Allah.
